checks.evidence: report.md, Outlook: says gross margin rises from its latest-period level toward the accepted glide path. model.json derived.gross_margin is 0.5354 (53.5%) for 2026-Q3-YTD; forecast_assumptions.json margin_glide.gross is [0.52, 0.525, 0.53, 0.53, 0.53], all below that level.

forecast_assumptions.json segment growth paths fall within mandate_bounds.forecast_bounds: Data Center 0.25 to 0.10 within [-0.05, 0.35]; Client and Gaming 0.08 to 0.04 within [-0.10, 0.20]; Embedded 0.05 to 0.00 within [-0.20, 0.05]. Gross margin glide 0.52 to 0.53 is within [0.18, 0.55].

The proposal tapers growth across all three segments. Its cited drivers describe strong recent Data Center growth, moderating Client and Gaming performance, and a cautious Embedded recovery, consistent with the proposal paths and the historical values in the cited driver text.
valuation.json cross_check_delta is -0.1139, within the mandate tolerance of 0.25; report.md states the DCF and relative valuation cross-check is within tolerance.

The note's Q3 comparisons use 2026-Q3 versus 2025-Q3, and its nine-month comparisons use 2026-Q3-YTD versus 2025-Q3-YTD. The stated Q3 revenue growth of 44.7% matches model.json income_statement.revenue yoy for 2026-Q3. No QoQ comparison is presented.

valuation.json terminal.reconciliation ratio is 2.2041, outside the 0.35 tolerance; terminal.target_flag is terminal_values_outside_tolerance. report.md discloses the material difference between Gordon-growth and exit-multiple terminal values.

findings.summary: The note says forecast gross margin rises from the latest-period level, but every forecast glide value is below the latest nine-month margin.
